meta_description: 13K likes, 149 comments - chrisburkard on October 10, 2026: "Day 3 of Fat biking & Pack rafting down the Oregon Coast Trail started in a thick fog with some hard high-tide pedaling. Crossing the Nestucca was choppy and pretty intense with the wind and being unable to see the other side. But after the first river crossing the tide began to retreat revealing nice firm sand for riding and a hint of sun through the clouds. By the time we reached Lincoln City it was bright and beautiful. We got a whole lot of excited questions and curious looks from the fisherman when we started blowing up our rafts and prepping to paddle the Siletz River. The fog returned later in the day but was a lot spottier and getting some rad riding through the woods made up for it. We ended the day warming up with fish, chips, and chowder at Mo’s in Lincoln City which felt very appropriate for another excellent day on the Oregon Coast. ~150 miles down and 219 to go!".
